summary: Tested the Notifications deep dive on the frontend at 390x844 (Updates tab, /notifications, notification-preferences) with demo@amass.africa and delivered@resend.dev. Working: the Unread filter chip (filters correctly and is remembered across tab switches and page reloads), fast swipes right and left with Undo, Mark unread on read rows, removal and Undo-restore while the Unread filter is on, Clear-read two-tap (arm, disarm after 4s, confirm, success toast, unread rows stay), the swipe hint, the empty state for the Unread filter, the Email summary card (toggle, Daily/Weekly, hour chips, caption, persistence, the expected error toast for demo's Send test), per-category Phone/Email chips (flip, persist after reload, hint when phone alerts are off), the digest frequency segmented control, and regression on /notifications (Unread chip, swipe, notif-mark-all). One HIGH bug: a swipe whose drag lasts more than ~600ms (a normal slow thumb swipe) also fires the row's onPress. That opens the deep link and decrements the unread count twice. Minor: the tab badge does not update after swipes. No deprecated Expo packages found.

ui_bugs.issue: The guard swipedRecently() only checks for 600ms after the last mark(). mark() runs at drag start (onSwipeableOpenStartDrag). onSwipeableOpen and onSwipeableWillClose run later via runOnJS, after the web click/onPress has already fired on mouseup. So any drag held longer than ~600ms ends with onPress → router.push(deep link) and openNotif marks the row read. Reproduced twice: a 1084ms right drag navigated to /agent/listing/1d8d3349...?tab=docs, and a ~700ms drag navigated to /agent/listing/3998e99b.... Fast drags (200-530ms) behaved correctly.

ui_bugs.component: Unread count double-decrement (result of the bug above)
ui_bugs.issue: On a slow swipe-right, openNotif() calls bump(n,true) and then toggleRead(n) calls bump(n,true) again with the stale unread `n`. updates-subtitle went from 22 to 20 for one row. After Undo it showed 21 while the server had 22, so the local count drifted.

There is no resting partially-open state. A drag below the 67px threshold snaps closed. A drag past it opens the row, and onSwipeableOpen fires the action immediately. The pane is always rendered under the row, so tapping its area after a partial swipe hits the row Pressable and opens the deep link. So 'partial swipe then tap the pane' cannot be reached. This is acceptable, but the pane onPress is effectively dead code.

integration_issues.issue: tab-badge-updates comes from useBadges in (tabs)/_layout.tsx, which polls every 30s. After a swipe, mark read or mark-all, the header updated at once but the tab badge stayed at 22 (and showed nothing with 2 unread after mark-unread) until the next poll. The feed's onUnreadChange should push the new total to the tab bar, e.g. through a shared context or an event.

issues: Email toggle (prefs-email-toggle) is 46x26 and the hour/frequency chips are 36px tall, under the 44pt touch target. Add hitSlop.
When the rail is scrolled, the hour chip rail clips the first chip ('06:00' shows as '00') at the card edge. Add horizontal content padding or fade edges.
The channel chip row (In-app · Phone · Email) wraps onto 2 lines at 390px, leaving the Email chip alone on the second line. Use smaller chips or a tighter gap so they fit on one line.

design_issues.screen: Updates – empty state for the Unread filter
issues: The 'Show all categories' and 'Show read updates' buttons sit ~10px from the screen edges. Use 16px side padding.
Chip and channel-chip components expose no aria-selected/accessibilityState.selected, so the selected state is not announced (notif-unread-only, notif-group-*, prefs-push-*, prefs-email-*).

action_items: HIGH: Fix the swipe deep-link guard in SwipeableNotification/NotificationFeed. Replace the 600ms time window with a movement check. Option 1: record pageX in the row Pressable's onPressIn and ignore onPress if |dx| > 8px. Option 2: keep an 'isDragging' ref set in onSwipeableOpenStartDrag/onSwipeableCloseStartDrag and cleared ~300ms after onSwipeableClose/onSwipeableOpen; openNotif returns early while it is set.
HIGH: Make toggleRead/openNotif work from the latest item state rather than the closure `n`, so a stray onPress during a swipe cannot double-bump counts.
MEDIUM: Sync tab-badge-updates with the feed after swipes, mark-all and clear-read: expose a refresh from useBadges via context or call it from onUnreadChange.

LOW: Add hitSlop to prefs-email-toggle and the chips, pad the hour rail, fit the channel chips on one line, set accessibilityState={{selected}} on Chip, and add side padding to the empty-state buttons.
Optional: drop or redesign the pane onPress, since it cannot be reached (a partial swipe never stays open).
critical_code_review_comments: SwipeableNotification.tsx:19-23. The time-based guard (600ms since drag start) is the root cause of the deep-link leak. runOnJS callbacks for open/close arrive after the web click.
NotificationFeed.tsx:368-373. The clearRead setTimeout is never cleared. If you arm, confirm and re-arm within 4s, the old timer disarms the new arm early. Use a ref and clearTimeout.

notification-preferences.tsx:52-64. The optimistic save() captures `before` from a stale closure. Rapid successive chip taps that fail can revert to an outdated snapshot. Use a functional setPrefs or a request queue.

NotificationFeed.tsx:259. useBounceRefresh(() => load(category)) is fine. Clear-read only filters loaded pages locally, while the server clears all read items in the category. That is acceptable because readCount resets to 0.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (22/25 checks passed; slow-swipe guard, count double-decrement and tab-badge sync failed)

seed_data_creation: None. Side effects on demo@amass.africa: most notifications marked read through mark-all (2 left unread). One read 'Free furniture' row in the nearby_free category was dismissed by Clear-read. Email digest is set to on, Daily at 18:00. Messages channel chips were restored to Phone+Email on. delivered@resend.dev: email digest turned on and 1 test email sent (backend 200 OK, then 429 on an immediate retry).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login at /login (testIDs login-email/login-password/login-submit-button). Row testIDs are duplicated when /notifications is pushed over the tabs, so scope selectors under [data-testid=updates-activity-list] or [data-testid=notif-list]. Swipe with page.mouse down, 6 moves of 150px over ~200ms, then up. To reproduce the guard bug, spread 16 moves over ~1s. Profile → menu-notifications opens /notifications. The success toast for delivered@resend.dev Send test was not captured by the DOM query (likely auto-dismissed before the 6s check), but the backend log shows 200 OK; a resend within 5 minutes returns 429.
rca_of_issue: Deep-link-on-swipe: on web, RNGH Pan runs on the JS thread, but its JS callbacks are dispatched via runOnJS. The Pressable child gets pointerup/click synchronously on mouseup and calls openNotif. swipedRecently() compares against lastSwipeAt, which was last set at drag start (onSwipeableOpenStartDrag). onSwipeableOpen and onSwipeableWillClose only fire after release, once the animation is done. So if drag start → release takes ≥600ms, the guard returns false and router.push runs. Repro: Updates tab, mouse-drag an unread row right by 150px over ~1s, release. Result: navigates to the listing docs page, toast 'Marked as read' appears there, and the subtitle drops by 2. Fix: gate on pointer travel distance or on a dragging flag instead of time.
